```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(extrafont)
library(cowplot)
library(car)
library(lme4)
library(effectsize)
library(broom)
library(effects)
```

```{r}
# function to define the B3 lab theme
theme_B3 <- function () { 
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),  # remove major gridlines
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),  # remove minor gridlines
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), # center & bold
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold") # center & bold 
    )
}
```
```{r figure out working directory}
getwd()
```

#1.import raw qPCR data 
  #raw data MUST have the following columns in long format: gene, sample, cq, tissue
  #exclude H2O wells from this dataset as they will throw off code 
```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/Chapter2_cropmilk/R_markdowns/qpcr_crop_compile.csv", stringsAsFactors = F)
```

#2.import key with relevant treatment groups for ddCT method 
  #key MUST have the following columns: sample, treatment 
```{r}
key <-read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/keys/parent_key.csv")
```

#3. merge key and raw data
```{r}
raw_data <- left_join(raw_data, key, by = "sample")
```
#4. define your control group (level of treatment that matches key above)
```{r}
control_group <- "paired female"
```

#5. define project / sample name 
```{r}
project_name <- "singleparent-crop"
```

#6. [OPTIONAL] if you want to normalize to specific reference genes, list names here
#names should match how they are entered in dataframe above
```{r}
custom_refgenes <- c("rpl4")
```

#7. Clean then generate log_fold change data
######################################################################
```{r}
#load packages
#use pacman to install and load all packages required
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman") #install pacman if not already installed
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, dplyr,broom,naniar)

#source functions
source("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/codeANDdatasets_Chapter2and3/qpcr_processing_functions_NOCHANGE.R")

#clean and join data 
colnames(raw_data) <- tolower(colnames(raw_data))
raw_data2 <- 
  raw_data %>%
  mutate(gene = tolower(gene)) %>% #all lowercase genes 
  replace_with_na(replace = list(gene = "")) %>% #blank to NA
  drop_na(gene) 

#join with project key 
#adds treatment group for normalizing expression 

colnames(key) <- tolower(colnames(key))

dat_joined <- inner_join(raw_data2, key) #joins by "sample"

#clean triplicates
dat_clean <- clean_triplicates(dat_joined)

#average cq across triplicates (returns 1 avg cq value for each sample:gene)
dat_avg <- avg_triplicates(dat_clean)
```
#8. get dct values.
```{r}
#get average reference gene and dct
dat_dct <- 
  dat_avg %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(is_ref = ifelse(gene %in% reference_genes, 1, 0),
         ref_gene = mean(mean_cq[gene %in% custom_refgenes], na.rm = T)) %>% #get average reference gene
  mutate(dct = mean_cq - ref_gene) #calculate dct
# make subset for 449
dat_449 <- subset(dat_dct, sample == 449) # copy and paste the dct values when determining ddct.
```

#9 get Rq values
```{r}
#just need one set
dat_gr <- subset(dat_dct, gene == "gr")

# subtract one paired dct control from all the treatment groups
dat_ddct <-
  dat_gr %>% 
  mutate(ddct = dct - 8.544436) # using paired female 449


# get fold change (rq)
dat_qpcr <- 
  dat_ddct %>%
  group_by(sample, gene) %>%
  mutate(rq = 2^-(ddct)) %>%
  ungroup()

#get dataframe of controls 
control_genes <- 
  dat_qpcr %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(control_rq = mean(rq[treatment == control_group], na.rm = T)) # control = average rq for vehicle group

#join with control data by genes
dat_ddct_controls <- left_join(dat_qpcr, control_genes) #joins by gene

# FINAL PRODUCT: normalize rq, get log(rq_norm)
dat_gr_qpcr_final <- 
  dat_ddct_controls %>%
  group_by(sample, gene) %>%
  mutate(rq_norm = rq/control_rq,
         log_fold = log(rq_norm)) %>%
  ungroup()

#add sex category
dat_gr_qpcr_final$sex[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired male"] <- "male"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$sex[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single male"] <- "male"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$sex[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired female"] <- "female"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$sex[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single female"] <- "female"

# add nest type category
dat_gr_qpcr_final$type[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired male"] <- "paired parent"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$type[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single male"] <- "single parent"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$type[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired female"] <- "paired parent"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$type[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single female"] <- "single parent"
```

###Data Analysis
### Confirm Rq for ref sample is 1
```{r}
#just need one set
dat_gr_449 <- subset(dat_gr_qpcr_final, sample == "449")
dat_mr_449 <- subset(dat_mr_qpcr_final, sample == "449")
dat_prlr_449 <- subset(dat_prlr_qpcr_final, sample == "449")
dat_prl_449 <- subset(dat_prl_qpcr_final, sample == "449")
dat_oxtr_449 <- subset(dat_oxtr_qpcr_final, sample == "449")
```
# rq values all 1 or close to 1.

#confirm reference genes 
```{r}
#just need one set
dat_ref <- subset(dat_dct, gene == "rpl4")
#add sex category
dat_ref$sex[dat_ref$treatment == "paired male"] <- "male"
dat_ref$sex[dat_ref$treatment == "single male"] <- "male"
dat_ref$sex[dat_ref$treatment == "paired female"] <- "female"
dat_ref$sex[dat_ref$treatment == "single female"] <- "female"

# add nest type category
dat_ref$type[dat_ref$treatment == "paired male"] <- "paired parent"
dat_ref$type[dat_ref$treatment == "single male"] <- "single parent"
dat_ref$type[dat_ref$treatment == "paired female"] <- "paired parent"
dat_ref$type[dat_ref$treatment == "single female"] <- "single parent"
```
# incorporating brood size. 
```{r}
dat_ref <- left_join(dat_ref, key, by = c("sample","treatment"))
```


```{r}
ggplot(aes(y = ref_gene ,x = treatment, fill= treatment), data = dat_ref) + geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Refgene Expression", x="", y="ref gene Cq avg") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=14)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))
```

```{r}
leveneTest(ref_gene ~ treatment, data = dat_ref, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(ref_gene ~ brood, data = dat_ref, center = mean)
```
# so parametric test ok
```{r}
lmer_ref <- lmer(ref_gene ~ treatment+brood+(1 | nestid), data = dat_ref, REML = TRUE)
Anova(lmer_ref, type = "II", test = "F")
```
#so no significant difference between treatment groups in regards to reference genes. 
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(lmer_ref, type = "II", test = "F"))
```
# by nest-type and sex?
```{r}
leveneTest(ref_gene ~ type, data = dat_ref, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(ref_gene ~ sex, data = dat_ref, center = mean)
```
# so  parametric ok
```{r}
fit_ref_s <- aov(ref_gene ~ type*sex, data = dat_ref)
Anova(fit_ref_s, type = "II")
```

```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_ref_s, type = "II"))
```
# also no significant difference by nest-type or sex. 

### PRLR 
# incorporating brood size. 
```{r}
dat_prlr_qpcr_final <- left_join(dat_prlr_qpcr_final, key, by = c("sample","treatment"))
```

```{r}
#re-label axes
dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired male"] <- "paired father"
dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single male"] <- "single father"
dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired female"] <- "paired mother"
dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_prlr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single female"] <- "single mother"
```

```{r}
my_t_prlr <- expression("Crop" ~ paste(italic("PRLR")))
figprlr <- ggplot(aes(y = rq_norm,x = treatment, fill= treatment), data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_parent) +
  labs(title = my_t_prlr, x="", y="fold change to paired mothers") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "none") + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired mother", "paired father", "single mother", "single father"))
figprlr
```
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ treatment, data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ brood, data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
# so parametric fine. 
```{r}
lmer_prlr <- lmer(rq_norm ~ treatment+brood+(1 | nestid), data = dat_prlr_qpcr_final, REML = TRUE)
Anova(lmer_prlr, type = "II", test = "F")
```
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(lmer_prlr, type = "II", test = "F"))
```

```{r}
#re-label axes
dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired male"] <- "paired father"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single male"] <- "single father"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "paired female"] <- "paired mother"
dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment[dat_gr_qpcr_final$treatment == "single female"] <- "single mother"
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
my_t_gr <- expression("Crop" ~ paste(italic("GR")))
figgr <- ggplot(aes(y = rq_norm,x = treatment, fill= treatment), data = dat_gr_qpcr_final) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_parent) +
  labs(title = my_t_gr, x="", y="fold change to paired mothers") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "none") + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired mother", "paired father", "single mother", "single father"))
figgr
```
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ treatment, data = dat_gr_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ brood, data = dat_gr_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
# so should rank transform
```{r}
lmer_gr <- lmer(rank(rq_norm) ~ treatment+brood+(1 | nestid), data = dat_gr_qpcr_final, REML = TRUE)
Anova(lmer_gr, type = "II", test = "F")
```

```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(lmer_gr, type = "II", test = "F"))
```
# by nest type and sex
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ type, data = dat_gr_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(rq_norm ~ sex, data = dat_gr_qpcr_final, center = mean)
```
# so parametric test ok 
```{r}
fit_gr_s <- aov(rq_norm ~ type*sex, data = dat_gr_qpcr_final)
Anova(fit_gr_s, type = "II")
```

```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_gr_s, type = "II"))
```

```{r}
dat_mr_qpcr_final <- left_join(dat_mr_qpcr_final, key, by = c("sample","treatment"))
```
